title: Bernstein Constraint Complexes for Multivariate Splines on Triangulated Surfaces
summary: We introduce Bernstein constraint complexes, a representation of finite element differential complexes in which every triangle of a triangulation keeps its own Bernstein--Bézier coefficients and global continuity is imposed only through smoothness functionals attached to edges and vertices. Continuity of scalar splines, tangential continuity of spline vector fields, normal continuity of spline vector fields, and higher smoothness differ only in the edge functionals.
